Neither summary states startup power: the checked value goes into the sentence that names the quantity (its value replaced), else after the sentence about its subject ("Startup takes 45 ms. Startup power is 10.8 W."), else after the last sentence.

The report update is two-phase (K1 fixes an approve step's inputs when authorised): step 3 checks the report and prepares the change (libreoffice.prepare, a read); once done, K1's new AFTER_STEP hook lets K4 plan step 4 (libreoffice.replace) with the checked value fixed.
